reviews.reason: Instruction, essentials, and an intention are different objects of the same act of disclosing or showing; public setting does not create another referent.
Biographical verdicts, verse titles, and challenged claims retain the event-label 'awaken to the Way'; approval versus criticism is appraisal, not polysemy.
Different preceding sayings, gestures, and addressees retain the same public question 'how do you understand it?'
Pearl, whisk, staff, and person predicates all retain the whole body or entirety; predication does not establish another thing.
Question, answer, blow, and appraisal differ while the relation remains meeting the public occasion directly.
Unlike recorded answers do not change the lexical identity of the same question 'what is the Way?'
Changing scoped predicates retain the distributive adverb 'wherever/in every place'; predicate variation is not a lexical split.
Great matter, mind-ground, and essentials are objects brought to light by the same transitive action.
Doubling, bodily consequences, and speaker position vary while every witness is the imperative 'speak, quickly!'
Immediate occurrence 'on the spot' and literal bodily standing at a place are independently anchored different things, not alternate readings of one event.
